learnerPsychometricProxies.name: EdNet
learnerPsychometricProxies.scale: More than 780,000 users; KT1 has 784,309 user files
learnerPsychometricProxies.restriction: Psychometric pipeline proxy only; never use its item difficulty as MouldMaster item difficulty.

learnerPsychometricProxies.name: Riiid Answer Correctness Prediction
learnerPsychometricProxies.scale: ~100M learner interactions / 390k+ users in the challenge data
learnerPsychometricProxies.restriction: Competition terms apply; calibration proxy only.

learnerPsychometricProxies.name: Eedi NeurIPS Education Challenge
learnerPsychometricProxies.scale: Tasks 1/2: 27,613 questions, 118,971 students, 15,867,850 answers; tasks 3/4 add 1,382,727 answers
learnerPsychometricProxies.restriction: Use for assessment-system calibration concepts, not domain transfer.

learnerPsychometricProxies.name: ASSISTments datasets
learnerPsychometricProxies.scale: Multiple public/research datasets; 2017 challenge has 942,816 response records in commonly cited preprocessing
learnerPsychometricProxies.restriction: Some specific releases require free signup/terms.

learnerPsychometricProxies.name: Junyi Academy learning activity dataset
learnerPsychometricProxies.scale: 16,217,311 problem attempts from 72,630 selected students in the 2018-2019 public release

learnerPsychometricProxies.name: Open University Learning Analytics Dataset (OULAD)
learnerPsychometricProxies.scale: 32,593 student records; 173,912 assessment records; 10,655,280 VLE interaction rows in commonly distributed tables

learnerPsychometricProxies.name: Duolingo 2018 SLAM learner dataset
learnerPsychometricProxies.scale: 7 million learner-produced words / 6,000+ users over 30 days (Duolingo research page description)
learnerPsychometricProxies.restriction: CC BY-NC / shared-task terms; domain proxy only.

learnerPsychometricProxies.name: XES3G5M
learnerPsychometricProxies.scale: 5,549,635 interactions, 18,066 students, 7,652 questions and 865 knowledge components
learnerPsychometricProxies.restriction: Domain proxy only; respect dataset download license.

learnerPsychometricProxies.name: DBE-KT22
learnerPsychometricProxies.domain: University database systems; NOT injection moulding
learnerPsychometricProxies.scale: Public online-exercise dataset from an Australian National University course; published processed benchmarks report roughly 1,140 students, 212 questions and 306k interactions depending preprocessing
learnerPsychometricProxies.restriction: Domain proxy only; exact row counts depend on published preprocessing.

learnerPsychometricProxies.name: MOOCCubeX
learnerPsychometricProxies.domain: Massive open online courses; NOT injection moulding
learnerPsychometricProxies.scale: 4,216 courses, 358,265 exercises, 637,572 concepts, >296 million raw behavioral events from 3,330,294 students
learnerPsychometricProxies.restriction: Very large dataset; useful mainly for telemetry/data-engineering stress tests.

learnerPsychometricProxies.name: KDD Cup 2010 — Algebra I 2005-2006
learnerPsychometricProxies.restriction: Development dataset; known data-quality caveats documented by KDD.

learnerPsychometricProxies.name: KDD Cup 2010 — Algebra I 2006-2007
learnerPsychometricProxies.restriction: Development dataset; KDD documents a historical file bug that was corrected.

learnerPsychometricProxies.name: KDD Cup 2010 — Algebra I 2008-2009
learnerPsychometricProxies.restriction: Challenge dataset has known timestamp/duration quality issues; do not use its time fields as a clean response-time benchmark.

learnerPsychometricProxies.name: KDD Cup 2010 — Bridge to Algebra 2008-2009
learnerPsychometricProxies.restriction: Challenge dataset; use KDD's documented data-quality notes.
